privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.desc: How Office Lab handles your files: browser tools upload nothing, and the server version deletes each file as soon as it is converted.
privacy.lead: Office Lab is built so that your files stay with you. This page explains exactly what happens to a file in each case.
privacy.browser.p: Every tool marked “Runs on your device” works on the file inside your own browser; the file never leaves your device. You can check it yourself: open the tool, disconnect from the internet, and it still works.
privacy.server.p: Some heavy conversions (such as Word to PDF) need a server. Then the file is uploaded over an encrypted connection (HTTPS), converted in a temporary folder of its own, and deleted as soon as the conversion ends; any leftovers are removed automatically within an hour at most. We keep no copies and never log file contents: the log holds only the tool name, the time and the size.
privacy.translate.p: The free translation runs on your device. “Professional translation” sends the text (not the file) to Anthropic's Claude to translate it, and is used only when you choose it.
privacy.storage.p: No tracking cookies, no ads, no analytics. The only things kept in your browser are your choices: language, dark mode, the invoice draft and the tool chains you save — you can clear them in your browser settings.
privacy.offline.p: If you install Office Lab as an app or turn on offline use, the browser keeps the site's own files (not yours) so it works without a connection.
privacy.source.p: Office Lab is fully open source, so anyone can read the code and confirm all of the above.
about.title: About Office Lab
about.desc: Office Lab: free, open-source tools for office files — Arabic-first, running on your device.
about.lead: Office Lab is a set of free tools for everyday office files — PDF, images, Word, Excel and text — Arabic-first, and without uploading your files anywhere.
about.counts: {all} tools: {local} run inside your browser, {server} need the server version.
about.why.1: Privacy: most tools run on your device, so your contracts and invoices are not uploaded to sites you don't know.
about.why.2: Arabic first: right-to-left layout, proper Arabic fonts in PDFs, amounts in words, Hijri dates and Arabic OCR.
about.why.3: Free and open source (AGPL-3.0): no subscription, no watermark, no daily limits.
about.install.p: Install Office Lab on your computer or phone from the browser menu (“Install app” or “Add to Home screen”). On a phone it then appears in the Share menu, so you can send files to it directly.
about.offline.p: Tools you have used once keep working offline. You can also get every browser tool ready in one go (about {mb} MB):
about.offline.done: Done: every browser tool now works offline.
about.offline.fail: Some files could not be saved. Check your connection and try again.
about.offline.none: Your browser does not support offline use.
about.credits.p: Thanks to these projects: pdf-lib, pdf.js, Tesseract.js, jSquash, SheetJS, mammoth, transformers.js and the OPUS-MT models, and on the server version LibreOffice, Gotenberg, calibre, pandoc, OCRmyPDF and Ghostscript.
